title: polypodium hygroscopicum
intro: Polypodium hygroscopicum, commonly known as "Shamrock fern" or "Resurrection fern," is a species of fern native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is known for its unique ability to dry out and revive when exposed to water, making it a symbol of resilience. The health benefits of Polypodium hygroscopicum include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may aid in wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects.
